title: Welcome to Lattiora
subtitle: Read papers and take notes alongside your AI assistant. A few quick steps to set up your workspace.

theme.title: Pick your look
theme.desc: Choose a color scheme you like — you can change it anytime in Settings.

proxy.title: Set up network access
proxy.desc: Use a local proxy when academic sites, GitHub, or Agent downloads need one.
proxy.hint: Leave the switch off to connect directly, or enable it for a local HTTP/SOCKS proxy.

agent.title: Choose your AI assistant
agent.desc: Configure the unified AI service for paper summaries and questions. Your API key is encrypted in Cloudflare; model usage is billed by your provider.
agent.none: No agents found yet. Install one on this computer (e.g. OpenCode, or Claude Code plus its ACP adapter), then click Rescan.

translate.title: Set up translation
translate.desc: Choose a translation service or configure your own API in Settings. No API service or key is bundled.
translate.configureOwn: I have my own translation API
translate.configureOwnDesc: Bring your own DeepL or other translation API key.
translate.useDefaultDesc: Use your configured AI. Configure a provider in Settings before translating.
translate.probeFail: Check your key and try again

layout.title: Spot figures and formulas automatically
layout.configureOwnDesc: Bring your own Paddle, MinerU, or OpenAI-compatible API key for the best accuracy on figures and formulas.
layout.useDefaultDesc: Run the original layout model in this browser. Download 62.5 MiB of weights once for offline use.
layout.probeFail: Check your key and try again

vault.title: Your workspace is ready
vault.desc: Import files now or finish setup and use Import later.
vault.createDesc: Choose a separate Lattiora folder first. After it is created, you can import from Zotero.
vault.zoteroOfferDesc: Your Lattiora vault is ready. You can now choose a Zotero data folder as the import source.

sidebar.title: Your library & vault
sidebar.desc: The sidebar holds your library and workspace files. Files are cached in this browser, synced to your Cloudflare deployment and exportable as ordinary files.

library.title: Papers library
library.desc: Every paper in your vault shows up here. Sort columns, filter by tags, edit metadata and export BibTeX in one place.

coolPapers.title: Cool Papers
coolPapers.desc: Browse arXiv highlights and trending papers. One click opens an interesting paper in the workspace.

magicWand.title: One-click import
magicWand.desc: Paste a DOI, arXiv ID or link to import a paper. {{magicWandShortcut}} opens this dialog anytime.

readPaper.title: Read & take notes
readPaper.desc: Click the lightning bolt on any paper to open it with the PDF on the left and NOTES.md on the right, ready for highlights and annotations.

workspace.title: Split-screen reading
workspace.desc: Open any paper to split the view: PDF on the left, NOTES.md on the right. Select text to highlight, annotate, translate or ask questions.

fullTextTranslate.title: Full-text translation
fullTextTranslate.desc: The PDF toolbar can translate the whole paper at once. Run it once, then browse the translation inline or open it side-by-side.

fetchCoolPapersNotes.title: Cool Paper notes
fetchCoolPapersNotes.desc: While editing a paper's NOTES.md, click this button to fetch public Kimi notes from Cool Papers and merge them into your own notes.

agent.title: Your agent, ready to help
agent.desc: Configure the unified AI provider and API key in Settings. The current paper joins the context for summaries and questions.

titlebar.title: Start exploring
titlebar.desc: {{settingsShortcut}} opens Settings and {{quickOpenShortcut}} opens files quickly. Use Import to start organizing your papers.
